scope: Remaining priorities 3–5: text embeddings, municipal economic exposures, complementary municipalities. V8.1 remains frozen.

stages.name: Target-blind text corpus and embeddings
tasks: Read only object title metadata and source-specific pre-vote brochure tables
Audit source/date/hash and unique high-confidence title correspondences; abstain from uncertain links; do not certify historical editions
Compare title and brochure-enhanced text separately; lexical TF-IDF and frozen multilingual E5 embeddings; train-only transformations
Compare text additions to the same PCA5 recent structural regressor and V8.1 anchor
stages.gate: Exact object keys; no outcome columns; documented coverage, model revision and hashes; matched V8.1 reference

stages.name: Economic source and interactions
tasks: Acquire official STATENT annual counts, employment sectors and establishments; audit codes, suppressed cells, geography
Harmonize 2024 to 2026 via official mutations, reject unresolved splits; use data year at least two years before vote
Fit regularized object × municipality interactions to residuals, compare control, economic-only and demographic + economy where available; all municipalities remain scored
stages.gate: Publication proxy documented, no future-year join, no zero filling of suppressed cells, matched baseline

stages.name: Complementary commune profiles
tasks: Select diverse municipalities using only train-period PCA loadings and coverage; fixed D-optimal criterion with random control
Measure held-out reconstruction from observed panel shares as explicitly non-forecast oracle
Fit predictive panel heads from pre-vote object features; reconstruct all municipalities using predicted panel shares only; compare direct PCA regression
stages.gate: Never use actual held-out panel votes in forecast; same full population; report oracle separately

stages.name: Report
tasks: Keep separate ablations and uncertainty; report failures and data limitations
Archive code, scores, provenance, and no promotion on reused dates

limitations: Retrospective source versions, geography and E5 pretraining cannot be certified as available at historical forecast cutoff. The strict pipeline is unchanged. No 2023+ outcomes used in scoring or fitting. No individual vote inference.
